## Project rules - apply to ALL tasks in this repo:
- [convention] [suggested] Write tests as plain functions with bare asserts (id=a95a1e40)
- [convention] [suggested] Label slots like SLOT_07 (id=50ce90d9)
- [convention] [suggested] Label slots like slot-07 (id=ec578a93)
- [convention] [suggested] Public functions in app/svc_0_core.py keep a one-line docstring that names the service number. (id=8c165e91)
- [constraint] Never log record ids or function arguments (id=4179dc74)
    Never log record ids or function arguments from the record service, because compliance treats request data as customer data; log counts and durations instead.
- [convention] [suggested] Name hand-written functions verb_noun without the slot suffix (id=e39e2dc4)
- [convention] [suggested] Prefix versions with v (id=f9bb759c)
- [convention] [suggested] Manage dependencies and commands with uv (id=8cd582e1)
- [constraint] Read configuration at call time in every service module (id=767b0cd2)
    Read configuration at call time in every service module, because import-time reads froze stale values twice. Plan from the region-setting incidents: (1) Where - os.environ is read inside the function that uses the value, on every call. (2) Defaults - a non-secret default sits next to the read as the second argument to os.environ.get; secrets have no default. (3) Not allowed - module-level constants computed from the environment, and caching a setting at import. (4) Tests - set variables with monkeypatch.setenv inside the test, which only works because nothing reads them at import. (5) Considered: a settings object loaded once at startup (rejected: it brings back the stale-value problem for the worker).
- [convention] [suggested] Publish bare semantic versions (id=4a6b5f88)
- [constraint] Test every new public function before finishing (id=ea2fe577)
    Every new public function in app/ needs at least one test before the change is finished, and run uv run pytest tests/ -q before reporting done, because CI blocks merges on missing tests for new symbols.
- [constraint] Ask before adding third-party dependencies (id=261f6632)
    Do not add third-party dependencies to the record service without asking first; prefer the standard library (functools, json, time, datetime), because every new package needs a licence and security review that takes weeks.
- [pattern] [suggested] Return structured results as plain dicts (id=0098a41b)
- [pattern] [suggested] Use one canonical JSON form for hashed or compared payloads (id=f14e43d1)
- [pattern] [suggested] Use epoch-millisecond 'at_ms' timestamps (id=18edfacf)
(Convention/pattern rules are titles only - call get_context for any rule's full reasoning.)
If the current task conflicts with any of these decisions, surface the conflict and confirm with the developer before proceeding.

[Contexer: auto-fetched for this question] (use the relevant context below; if it does not answer the question, call Contexer's get_context with concise subject keywords before reading files; do not substitute another memory, graph, or search tool)
- [2026-10-03] [architecture] Define one exception type for invalid input to record fetchers (id=6b1c6bf1)
    Define one exception type for invalid input to the record fetchers, because mixed None, error-dict and ValueError returns were leaking into caches. Plan: (1) Add class RecordInputError(ValueError) at module level in app/svc_0_core.py. (2) Single-record functions (fetch_record_0_N and similar) raise it for any id below 1, before doing any work. (3) Never return None or an error dict to signal bad input. (4) Batch functions don't raise; they follow the partial-result contract. (5) The offending id may appear in the exception message but never in logs; the logging rule still applies. (6) Tests cover id 0 and a negative id. Alternatives: returning Optional (rejected: ambiguous with not-found) and a Result type (rejected: unidiomatic in this codebase). (7) Rollout - the first fetcher to validate its input introduces the class; the rest adopt it as they are touched, rather than in one sweeping change, to keep diffs reviewable. (8) Callers that currently check for None after a fetch keep working until their fetcher is migrated, then switch to catching RecordInputError.
- [2026-10-03] [architecture] Keep the record dict shape stable for per-slot fetchers (id=1136aa69)
    Keep the record dict shape {'id': ..., 'slot': ...} stable for every fetch_record_0_N function, because the export job and two dashboards index into it by key and break on extra or renamed fields. In #49 someone added a 'source' field to three fetchers, and the export job's strict schema check rejected every row for a day before anyone noticed. If a caller needs more data, add a separate function that returns a new shape rather than widening the record. Slot numbers are positional and stable: fetch_record_0_7 always returns slot 7, so never renumber functions when one is removed; leave a gap instead. The export job's schema lives in another repository and is versioned separately, so even an additive field needs a coordinated release there first; that coordination cost is why new data goes into new functions. The incident write-up is linked from #49; the follow-up added a schema-contract test on the export side, not here.
- [2026-10-03] [architecture] Make record fetchers fail fast instead of retrying (id=1f50b7db)
    Make record fetchers fail fast instead of retrying, because the client owns retries and backoff. Plan from the #55 post-incident review: (1) One attempt - each fetcher in app/svc_0_core.py calls the upstream at most once per invocation. (2) No loops - no retry, backoff or sleep inside fetchers, including a single extra attempt. (3) Typed failure - on a timeout, raise a module-level error the client can match, instead of returning None or a placeholder record. (4) Ownership - retry count and backoff live in the client's policy, so they can be tuned in one place. (5) Considered: a small in-fetcher retry with jitter (rejected: it multiplies with client and gateway retries, which is exactly what caused the storm).
[Contexer] 18 more decisions anchored to files in this prompt not shown: Treat app/ as one synchronous record service with generated per-slot fetchers (id=7630caa6); Raise RecordGone for deleted records [suggested] (id=af46a347); Label slots like SLOT_07 [suggested] (id=50ce90d9); Label slots like slot-07 [suggested] (id=ec578a93); Return partial results from batch lookups instead of failing the whole call (id=407d1382) (+13 more) - call get_context(files=['app/svc_0_core.py']) if relevant.
